Welcome
Welcome to our school website.
As Headteacher, I am delighted to welcome you to our caring and nurturing Church school, where every child is valued, encouraged, and inspired to flourish. pageCache.text:
Safeguarding Curriculum
Safeguarding is embedded throughout our curriculum, helping pupils to develop the knowledge, skills, and confidence they need to stay safe, healthy, and happy. Through our Personal, Social, Health and Economic (PSHE) education, Relationships Education, Computing, and wider curriculum opportunities, children learn about topics such as online safety, healthy relationships, mental wellbeing, personal boundaries, consent, bullying, and how to seek help when they need it.
We encourage pupils to become responsible, respectful, and resilient individuals who understand how to keep themselves and others safe. By providing regular opportunities to discuss real-life issues in an age-appropriate way, we help children develop the confidence to make informed decisions, recognise risks, and know that trusted adults are always available to support them.
Through a culture of openness and care, safeguarding education equips our pupils with the tools they need to thrive both in school and beyond.

School Opening Hours
School opening hours
Our school gates open at 8.35am. A member of staff will be on the gate to greet the children.
The compulsory school hours are from 8.45am when the register is taken until 3.10pm for Early Years and KS1 and 3.15pm for KS2.
Children are greeted by their class teams at the classroom doors.
Registration is at 8.45am
Our school office is open from 8.00am to 4.00pm. Mrs Wilcox and Mrs Jeffery are available to help you with any queries so please call them on 01264 352322.
Our usual school day
9.15am Phonics or spelling
9.30am Morning session 1
10.45am Morning session 2
11.50am EY and KS1 lunch
12.55pm Afternoon registration
1.00-3.00pm Afternoon lessons
3.10/3.15pm Home time
